description: This file defines the EntityFindOptions class which encapsulates various parameters for customizing database entity find operations in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes configuration options for result set type, concurrency, fetch size, limits, and other advanced query options.

classes.name: EntityFindOptions
classes.description: A serializable Java class to specify advanced options for entity finding operations, including result set types, concurrency modes, fetch sizes, limits, skips, and distinct filtering.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing default query options.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to set specific find options such as type, concurrency, fetch size, max rows, and distinct flag.

methods.name: getSpecifyTypeAndConcur
methods.description: Returns whether to specify result set type and concurrency.

methods.name: setSpecifyTypeAndConcur
methods.description: Sets whether to specify result set type and concurrency.

methods.name: getResultSetType
methods.description: Returns the configured result set type.

methods.name: setResultSetType
methods.description: Sets the result set type for the query.

methods.name: getResultSetConcurrency
methods.description: Returns the configured result set concurrency mode.

methods.name: setResultSetConcurrency
methods.description: Sets the result set concurrency mode.

methods.name: getFetchSize
methods.description: Returns the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: getMaxRows
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: setMaxRows
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: getDistinct
methods.description: Indicates whether to filter out duplicate results.

methods.name: setDistinct
methods.description: Sets whether to filter duplicate results.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for the number of results.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit for the number of results.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset (skip) for the results.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset (skip) for the results.
